== Course of events ==

Having been mistaken by the White Rabbit for his housemaid Mary Ann and dispatched to fetch his fan and gloves from his house, Alice finds herself within the Rabbit's dwelling. While searching within his room, she discovers an unlabeled bottle. Curious, as one might be in Wonderland's peculiar logic, she drinks from it. The effect is immediate and alarming: she begins to grow with startling rapidity, her body expanding until she becomes hopelessly trapped within the room's confines. Her limbs protrude grotesquely from the window and chimney, leaving her caught between walls and furniture, a creature too large for any ordinary dwelling.

The situation grows more desperate when the Rabbit and other animals outside, alarmed by her predicament, attempt to retrieve her. Among their efforts is the dispatch of a creature named Bill down the chimney, though Alice manages to kick him out with considerable violence. Throughout this harrowing sequence, Alice demonstrates remarkable resourcefulness in the face of her dangerous circumstances, finding ways to withstand the chaos of her extraordinary transformation and the frantic attempts at rescue unfolding around her.
